verdict.rationale: No evidence of any data export feature (mailbox, comments, snippets, etc.) in open formats; probes for llms.txt, docs-md, and openapi endpoints all returned 404, and no changelog/blog mentions an export or account-portability capability. Community threads mention deleting the account making it 'low-risk' to switch back to Gmail, but that is because Shortwave uses Gmail as the underlying store, not because Shortwave itself offers a data export mechanism. missing for 10: any documented export/download feature, supported open file formats, or migration/backup tooling.
